lastCompletedStory.title: Structured observability event + result line for the bump

nextStoryContext: US-007 changed ShipBumpResult from a discriminated union ({ noOp: true, reason } | { noOp: false, oldVersion, newVersion, bump }) to a unified interface { from, to, bumpType: BumpLevel, commitsClassified }. The no-op path now reads readVersionTs() so it can populate from/to even when no bump is performed (bumpType: none, from === to). Both paths emit an emitOk result line (msg: 'bump: <level> (N classified)', suffix: '<from> -> <to>' or '<from> (no change)') and call an optional writeEvent? injectable. ShipBumpOptions gained two optional fields: writeEvent? and emitResultLine?. The index.ts caller was simplified: it no longer reads the result to call printHint (the emitOk inside runShipBump handles it). All 1515 tests pass. Next story: check prd.json for the next passes:false entry.

officialDocsValidated.summary: US-007 only uses internal project modules (src/logging/screen.ts emitOk, src/release/bump.ts BumpLevel). No external npm library was touched; no fetch needed.
